content.comment_body: Why does the [product_name] need to be manually reset after a power outage? Upon restoring power, the device shows a steady red fault LED. I suspect there may be a configuration issue.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report reliability concerns with the [product_name], as it requires manual reset following a power loss. The device fails to automatically resume operation, indicated by a steady red fault LED. This points to a potential configuration or resilience issue that disrupts user processes.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to automatically recover from power outages and continue functioning without needing manual resets.
